title: Signed Receipts for AI Agent Audit Trails: A Measurement-Based Approach
abstract: We present a cryptographically signed receipt format for AI agent audit trails that captures both events and non-events (refusals, timeouts, silent drops). Using our 2,383-card measurement corpus covering 22 governance axes, we demonstrate that current AI agent protocols (MCP, A2A, x402) lack formal non-event capture mechanisms. Our approach extends the SCITT (Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust) evidence receipt format with a `non_event` field, Ed25519 signatures, and merkle-root anchoring to Bitcoin. We evaluate 425 stablecoins, 17 regulatory frameworks, and 92 protocol atoms to show that signed non-event receipts close a critical gap in AI governance infrastructure.
